Title: Científico de Datos
Description: ¡Únete a nuestro equipo como Científico de Datos! Importante empresa del sector financiero en México, con una sólida trayectoria y en plena expansión internacional, busca incorporar a un Científico de Datos apasionado por la innovación y el análisis de datos, que quiera sumarse a un equipo dinámico y diverso y ser parte de esta emocionante etapa de crecimiento. 🔎 Requisitos Título en Ciencias de Datos, Actuaria, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Business Intelligence o a fin. Experiencia en análisis de datos, modelado estadístico, machine learning y en infraestructura en la nube AWS, Cloud y Azure. Conocimientos en herramientas y lenguajes de programación como SQL, NonSQL, Python y R, QuickSigth, Habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. Inglés intermedio/avanzado. 🎯 Responsabilidades del puesto: Diseñar, desarrollar, validar y monitorear modelos predictivos y prescriptivos (churn, propensión, score, etc.). Diseñar modelos estadísticos y de machine learning desde la concepción hasta su implementación y monitoreo en producción. Asegurar la calidad de los datos: Garantizar la precisión, consistencia y confiabilidad de los datos utilizados en los modelos generados. Implementar políticas y procedimientos para mantener la calidad de los datos. Realizar pruebas A/B y evaluar su impacto estadístico y comercial. Asegurar que los datos se almacenen de manera segura y cumplan con las regulaciones y políticas de privacidad. Generar innovación y mejora continua, mediante la actualización constante de las últimas tendencias y avances en el campo de Ciencia de Datos y Analíticas para implementar nuevas tecnologías y metodologías en el equipo. Experiencia deseable: Explotación de fuentes de datos estadísticos públicos: INEGI (México), DANE (Colombia), IBGE (Brasil), INEI (Perú) y similares, para la construcción de variables socioeconómicas, demográficas y geoespaciales a nivel localidad o municipio. Construcción de índices compuestos (marginación, ruralidad, potencial comercial) y segmentación de territorios para priorizar zonas de entrada en nuevos mercados. Experiencia con algoritmos de ruteo y solución de problemas de tipo Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) y Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP), usando librerías como OR-Tools, NetworkX, o solvers de investigación de operaciones. Manejo de datos geoespaciales con herramientas como GeoPandas, QGIS o equivalentes, y experiencia en análisis de conectividad entre localidades (distancias, tiempos de desplazamiento, accesibilidad). 🤝 Prestaciones y beneficios adicionales: Sueldo Mensual de: $28,000 a $30,000 pesos mensuales antes de impuestos Prestaciones de ley y superiores. Posibilidades de crecimiento. 📍 Ubicación: Guadalajara, Jalisco 📌 Modalidad: 100% presencial ¡Forma parte de una organización con propósito y contribuye a cambiar vidas a través de la tecnología!

Title: Neuromorphic Applications Engineer- (Temporary Position)
Description: Job Details Job Description: This position requires candidates to upload a resume in English; you are welcome to upload multiple versions of your resume if you prefer but an English version of your resume will be required to be considered for this position. With the support of the Jalisco State Government, we offer a program for your development that includes learning through assignments in projects, specific courses on Semiconductor Development and different abilities to work in high-performance teams. For nearly a decade, Intel's Neuromorphic Computing Lab-together with a global ecosystem of 250+ research groups-has explored architectures, algorithms, and software inspired by the brain's extraordinary efficiency, scalability, and adaptability. Our Loihi series of research chips pioneered event-driven, sparse, and massively parallel neuro-inspired processing, fueling over 100 peer-reviewed publications that validate its promise. Now, we're entering an exciting new chapter: transforming these breakthroughs into real-world products that will power the coming era of physical AI systems-beyond the reach of GPUs and mainstream AI accelerators. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of computing, from transistor-level innovation to software abstractions, join us. Help define the next wave of AI technology that harnesses the proven advantages of Intel's neuromorphic computing technology with the versatility demanded by modern AI workloads. Position Overview Demonstrate the value of Intel's neuromorphic technologies by developing, implementing, and benchmarking algorithms for Intel's next-generation neuromorphic architecture to enable applications in edge computing, signal processing, and autonomous systems for the era of physical AI with groundbreaking performance and efficiency. Responsibilities Support the development and optimization of advanced AI algorithms and robotics applications for edge platforms powered by Intel's next-generation neuromorphic architecture. Evaluate and benchmark robotic applications-such as VLA models for drones and humanoids-on current and next-generation neuromorphic hardware. Validate Intel's neuromorphic SDK by running real-world robotics workloads, gathering metrics, and proposing targeted software enhancements to the core development team. Present findings and publish benchmark results in top-tier conferences and journals. About The Organization As part of Intel's CTO Office, you will join a vertically integrated incubation effort dedicated to bringing Intel's neuromorphic technology innovations to market. Our diverse team of engineers and researchers has pioneered sparse, event-based, neuromorphic architecture over multiple generations and is now focused on commercializing the technology in future Intel and partner products. Behavioral traits Systems‑Level Thinker: Demonstrates the ability to reason across the full computing stack—from hardware architecture and device constraints to algorithms, software abstractions, and end‑application behavior. Understands tradeoffs between performance, power efficiency, scalability, and programmability in neuromorphic systems. Curiosity‑Driven Innovator: Exhibits deep curiosity about brain‑inspired computing and emerging AI paradigms beyond conventional GPU‑centric approaches. Actively explores new ideas, architectures, and algorithms, and is motivated by solving problems that lack proven solutions. Research‑to‑Product Mindset: Balances scientific rigor with practical impact. Capable of translating experimental algorithms and benchmarking results into insights that inform hardware, SDK, and product decisions. Understands the difference between exploratory research and production‑ready engineering. Data‑Driven Experimenter: Approaches problem‑solving through systematic experimentation, benchmarking, and analysis. Designs rigorous evaluations for neuromorphic workloads, carefully measures performance and efficiency metrics, and uses data to guide optimization and recommendations. Adaptable and Comfortable with Ambiguity: Thrives in fast‑evolving, pre‑commercial environments where architectures, tools, and requirements are still maturing. Adapts quickly as hardware, SDKs, or priorities change, and maintains productivity despite incomplete specifications. Clear Technical Communicator: Articulate complex neuromorphic concepts, benchmark results, and architectural implications clearly and concisely to both expert and non‑expert audiences. Comfortable presenting findings internally and publishing results externally in top‑tier conferences and journals. Ethical and Responsible Technologist: Demonstrates awareness of responsible AI principles and the societal implications of deploying neuromorphic and autonomous systems, especially in physical AI and edge‑based applications. This position is a fixed-term opportunity lasting approximately 12 months Qualifications Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Minimum Qualifications Enrolled or graduated from a MSc or PhD program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience writing clean, efficient, and modular Python and C++ code. 2+ years of experience with deep/machine learning, mathematical optimization, and AI frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow). 1+ year of experience: Developing AI models for perception, reasoning, and control (e.g., YOLO, LLMs, or VLAs based on transformers or SSM architectures) Software development best practices (OO design, testing, debugging, documentation, version control, code reviews). Advance English level. Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship). Preferred Qualifications Experience with edge AI HW accelerators or event-based sensors. Experience in developing software for robotics or other real-time control systems. Experience with profiling and benchmarking algorithms and hardware architectures. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research. Job Type Intel Contract Employee Shift Shift 1 (Mexico) Primary Location: Mexico, Guadalajara Additional Locations: Business Group Intel makes possible the most amazing experiences of the future. You may know us for our processors. But we do so much more. Intel invents at the boundaries of technology to make amazing experiences possible for business and society, and for every person on Earth. Harnessing the capability of the cloud, the ubiquity of the Internet of Things, the latest advances in memory and programmable solutions, and the promise of always-on 5G connectivity, Intel is disrupting industries and solving global challenges. Leading on policy, diversity, inclusion, education and sustainability, we create value for our stockholders, customers, and society.
